title: MegaDerm & MegaFill
caption: MegaDerm stock at HIGHST: 3–5 mm / 5 × 6, 5 × 8, 5 × 10, 6 × 12 cm
note: 수화타입·건조타입과 MegaFill의 재료 형태를 소개합니다. 두께와 크기는 원내 보유 규격입니다. 사진의 좌우 제품 타입은 아직 지정하지 않았습니다.
speakerNote: MegaDerm is a sheet acellular dermal matrix. HIGHST stocks hydrated and freeze-dried types. The stated thickness and sizes describe HIGHST's inventory. MegaFill is a micronized form of acellular dermal matrix. The photograph is supplied by HIGHST. Individual packages are not assigned type labels.

title: Patient Questionnaires
note: 수술 전 설문: IIEF(국제발기능지수)와 PEDT(조루 진단 도구).
speakerNote: The preoperative evaluation includes the International Index of Erectile Function (IIEF) and the Premature Ejaculation Diagnostic Tool (PEDT).

title: Laboratory & Infection Screening

rows.head: Blood tests
rows.body:
Blood coagulation tests
Complete blood count (CBC)
Prostate-specific antigen (PSA)
Blood glucose
HbA1c (glycated hemoglobin)

rows.head: Screening and other tests
rows.body:
HPV testing
Syphilis testing
Urine testing
Liver function
Inflammatory markers

note: 수술 전 검사: 혈액응고검사, 일반혈액검사(CBC), 전립선특이항원(PSA), 혈당, 당화혈색소(HbA1c), HPV, 매독, 소변검사, 간기능검사, 염증수치 검사.
speakerNote: Preoperative testing includes blood coagulation tests, complete blood count (CBC), prostate-specific antigen (PSA), blood glucose, glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c), HPV and syphilis testing, urine testing, liver function and inflammatory markers.

title: Physical Examination

rows.head: Penile biothesiometry
rows.body:
Vibration perception threshold
Penile sensitivity assessment

note: 신체진찰: 이완 상태(flaccid)와 신장 상태(stretched)의 음경 길이 측정, 진동각 검사를 통한 음경 민감도 평가.
speakerNote: Physical examination includes penile length measurement in the flaccid and stretched states. Penile biothesiometry assesses vibration perception thresholds and penile sensitivity.

title: Surgical Preparation
subtitle: Shaving and Draping
note: 새로 촬영할 쉐이빙·드랩 영상 자리입니다. 영상 영역은 비워두었습니다.

title: Contour Step-off Correction

rows.head: Contour and discomfort
rows.body: Graft contour irregularity, discomfort during erection

title: Potential Complications
caption: Reported in ADM augmentation literature
note: 문헌에 보고된 합병증 범주만 정리했습니다. 하이스트의 발생률이나 실제 증례를 의미하지 않습니다. 발표할 합병증·대응 설명은 원장님 자료로 구체화합니다.
speakerNote: These categories are reported in published ADM augmentation literature. They do not represent HIGHST or MegaDerm-specific outcome data. No incidence rates are extrapolated to HIGHST.
